# Exercises

## Estimate a mean

A sample of eight delivery times, in minutes, reads 31, 28, 35, 30, 33, 29, 34
and 32.

1. Compute the sample mean and the sample standard deviation.
2. State one assumption the estimate depends on.

::: {.callout-tip title="Solution"}
The sample mean is $\bar{x} = 252 / 8 = 31.5$ minutes. The squared deviations
sum to 42, so the sample variance is $s^2 = 42 / 7 = 6$ and the standard
deviation is $s = \sqrt{6} \approx 2.45$ minutes.

The estimate assumes the eight deliveries are a random sample from the same
process, for example that they were not all made on one unusually quiet day.
:::
